# Public replay fixture boundaries

The Myson sheet HTML and Medtecs contact HTML are redacted public-web captures. Credential-shaped strings have been replaced with an explicit test-only marker. The original unredacted files remain local and must not be committed.

The TEWC viewer fixture is synthetic minimal metadata. It preserves only the public attachment filename, MIME type, published URLs, declared size and file identifier required by the parser. It is not the original Google viewer response or a native HTTP receipt.

The remaining TEWC issuer/master/redirect and previously published PDF fixtures exercise parser and transport boundaries offline. Mocked receipts and successful replay do not prove live availability, permissions, source coverage or new acquisition success.
